# parser and walk have no error handling

Calls to parser.parse and subsequent tree traversal are not wrapped in try/except; a parsing failure or unexpected tree-sitter Node behavior could raise an exception and interrupt analysis for the batch.

- `knowledge_compiler/extractors/typescript_analyzer.py` — `knowledge_compiler.extractors.typescript_analyzer.TypeScriptAnalyzer.analyze`
